title: Healthcare Staff Scheduling Software | Managed Service
description: Healthcare staff scheduling software that works for you, not against you. Our managed service builds physician and APP schedules and hands them back finished.
h1: Healthcare Staff Scheduling Software, Done For You
paragraph: Forget learning complex healthcare staff scheduling software. With Scheduling Wizard, you just submit your rules. We deliver a finished, compliant schedule.

cta.title: Stop Running Schedules on Spreadsheets
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices who already trust Scheduling Wizard with their schedules.

faq.answer: Healthcare staff scheduling software helps medical programs build, manage, and distribute workforce schedules. Whether you need traditional software depends on your team's capacity. Scheduling Wizard takes a different approach entirely, rather than giving you software to operate, it functions as a managed service. You submit your program's rules and receive finished, optimized schedules as Excel files, so your team never has to learn or maintain a scheduling platform.
faq.question: What is healthcare staff scheduling software and do I need it?

faq.answer: For a residency or fellowship we build the ACGME requirements in as the schedule is created rather than auditing it afterward: the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum rest, the 24-hour cap, and the specialty-specific Program Requirements. We work from the requirements your program tells us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change.
faq.question: How do you handle ACGME duty hours?

faq.answer: Most healthcare staff scheduling software is self-service; you buy it, learn it, and operate it yourself. Scheduling Wizard is a managed service. Programs submit their rules and our schedulers deliver a finished, ready-to-publish schedule. There is no platform to log into and no software to maintain. Many Scheduling Wizard clients also use the platform they already have alongside it. Scheduling Wizard handles schedule creation and optimization, while the platform you already use handles day-to-day schedule viewing.
faq.question: How is Scheduling Wizard different from other healthcare staff scheduling software?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard generates Block and rotation schedules, Call schedules with fairness optimization, Clinic schedules, and Attending physician schedules. All schedule types are optimized simultaneously so that rules in one schedule are automatically reflected across the others. Finished schedules are delivered as Excel spreadsheets that programs can upload directly to their existing publishing platform.
faq.question: What types of schedules does Scheduling Wizard generate?

faq.answer: With traditional healthcare staff scheduling software, institutional scheduling knowledge often leaves when a chief rotates out. With Scheduling Wizard, your program's rules, requests, and configurations are retained by the service year over year. Incoming chief residents inherit a working, optimized system and do not need to rebuild scheduling logic from scratch. This continuity is a core part of the managed service model.
faq.question: What happens to our scheduling setup when a new chief resident takes over?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard is designed for medical residency and fellowship programs, including chief residents, program directors, program coordinators, and GME offices. It is currently serving 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices. The service is also expanding to serve private practice administrators and managing partners who need complex physician scheduling without the overhead of self-service software.
faq.question: Who is Scheduling Wizard designed for?

items.title: Done For You Scheduling Delivery
items.description: Programs submit their rules and receive finished, optimized schedules as Excel files ready to publish. No platform to log into, no software to learn, no annual retraining when a new chief takes over.

items.title: Requirements Built In From the Start
items.description: We build each schedule to the rules that govern it. For a residency or fellowship that means the ACGME duty hour requirements and the specialty-specific Program Requirements. For a provider group or practice it means yours: coverage minimums, call equity, contractual obligations, time off and requests, and multiple sites where a group has them.

items.title: Knowledge That Survives Chief Rotations
items.description: Your program's scheduling rules, requests, and configurations persist with Scheduling Wizard year over year. Incoming chiefs inherit a working, optimized system instead of rebuilding from a blank spreadsheet.

items.title: Equitable Call and Weekend Distribution
items.description: Call burden, weekend shifts, and holiday assignments are algorithmically distributed across your resident cohort. Fair outcomes are calculated, not negotiated, eliminating disputes before they start.

items.title: Block Call Clinic Schedules in Sync
items.description: Block rotations, call schedules, clinic assignments, and attending coverage are optimized simultaneously. A rule in one schedule automatically propagates across the others, eliminating the domino effect of manual cross-schedule patching.

features.title: Built for How Residency Programs Actually Work
features.description: Every feature is designed to eliminate the operator burden on chief residents, coordinators, and program directors.

items.title: Software You Never Master

items.title: Compliance Left to Chance
